entries.content: export default JSON.parse("{\"schema\":\"ai-brain-source-note/1.0\",\"domain\":\"vtt-maps\",\"capabilities\":[\"class\",\"combat\",\"crop\",\"effect\",\"grid\",\"layer\",\"manifest\",\"map\",\"perspective\",\"quest\",\"random\",\"rules\"],\"provenance\":{\"sourceGroup\":\"active-session-runtime-c\",\"sourceType\":\"provided-project-material\",\"archiveHash\":\"be64160633c6ca96\"},\"title\":\"encounter_json_guide.md\",\"content\":\"# ActiveWorkspace Encounter JSON Guide\\n\\nActiveWorkspace encounters are ordinary JSON files loaded from **MOL Session \u2192 Encounter**. The same encounter can change while play is underway without replacing the page or rebuilding the map.\\n\\n## Grid and map rules\\n\\n- Every grid square is always **5 ft \u00d7 5 ft**.\\n- Uploaded maps are scanned for repeating horizontal and vertical grid lines.\\n- A successful scan records row count, column count, line spacing, grid origin, confidence, and cropped grid bounds.\\n- Until the supplied reference-grid set is available, use **Apply Manual Grid** when an image has faint, decorative, broken, or perspective-distorted lines.\\n- Token `size` is measured in occupied grid squares: `1` is 5 ft \u00d7 5 ft, `2` is 10 ft \u00d7 10 ft, and so on.\\n- No living visible token may finish movement on any square occupied by another living visible token.\\n- `wall` and `blocked` terrain cannot be entered. `difficult` and `water` cost additional movement. `hazard` squares are avoided by default unless a hostile's AI permits them.\\n\\n## Combatant example\\n\\n```json\\n{\\n  \\\"id\\\": \\\"ash-goblin-1\\\",\\n  \\\"type\\\": \\\"hostile\\\",\\n  \\\"name\\\": \\\"Ash Goblin Hexer\\\",\\n  \\\"x\\\": 18,\\n  \\\"y\\\": 9,\\n  \\\"size\\\": 1,\\n  \\\"hp\\\": 27,\\n  \\\"maxHp\\\": 27,\\n  \\\"ac\\\": 14,\\n  \\\"speed\\\": 30,\\n  \\\"initiativeBonus\\\": 3,\\n  \\\"stats\\\": {\\\"str\\\": 8, \\\"dex\\\": 16, \\\"con\\\": 12, \\\"int\\\": 13, \\\"wis\\\": 11, \\\"cha\\\": 10},\\n  \\\"saves\\\": {\\\"dex\\\": 5},\\n  \\\"resistances\\\": [\\\"fire\\\"],\\n  \\\"conditionImmunities\\\": [],\\n  \\\"actions\\\": [\\n    {\\n      \\\"id\\\": \\\"cinder-bolt\\\",\\n      \\\"name\\\": \\\"Cinder Bolt\\\",\\n      \\\"kind\\\": \\\"attack_roll\\\",\\n      \\\"toHit\\\": 5,\\n      \\\"damageRoll\\\": \\\"1d10+3\\\",\\n      \\\"damageType\\\": \\\"fire\\\",\\n      \\\"rangeFeet\\\": 60\\n    },\\n    {\\n      \\\"id\\\": \\\"smoke-bind\\\",\\n      \\\"name\\\": \\\"Smoke Bind\\\",\\n      \\\"kind\\\": \\\"save\\\",\\n      \\\"saveDC\\\": 13,\\n      \\\"saveAbility\\\": \\\"dex\\\",\\n      \\\"rangeFeet\\\": 30,\\n      \\\"concentration\\\": true,\\n      \\\"effects\\\": [\\n        {\\\"name\\\": \\\"Smoke Bound\\\", \\\"condition\\\": \\\"restrained\\\", \\\"durationRounds\\\": 3, \\\"saveEndAbility\\\": \\\"dex\\\", \\\"saveEndDC\\\": 13}\\n      ]\\n    }\\n  ],\\n  \\\"ai\\\": {\\\"mode\\\": \\\"controller\\\", \\\"avoidHazards\\\": true}\\n}\\n```\\n\\n## Supported action behavior\\n\\nActions can use attack rolls, saving throws, damage, healing, conditions, ongoing effects, resistance, immunity, vulnerability, concentration, and effect-ending saves.\\n\\nCommon fields are:\\n\\n- `kind`: `attack_roll`, `save`, `effect`, or `healing`.\\n- `toHit`, `damageRoll`, `damageType`, `rangeFeet`.\\n- `saveDC`, `saveAbility`, `halfOnSave`.\\n- `healingRoll`.\\n- `effects`: conditions or ongoing damage/healing.\\n- `concentration`: ends the actor's earlier concentration when a new concentration action begins.\\n- `targeting`: `single` or an area label, with `radiusFeet` for area actions.\\n- `priority`: optional AI preference.\\n\\nHostiles evaluate reachable legal positions, line of sight, target distance, current HP, armor class or saving throw weakness, resistances and immunities, active concentration, healing/damage threat, class-role hints, action value, terrain, and their configured AI mode.\\n\\n## Dynamic encounter events\\n\\nUse `dynamicEvents` to make an encounter change by round or turn. Supported action types include:\\n\\n- `message`\\n- `terrain` / `set_terrain`\\n- `clear_terrain`\\n- `apply_effect` / `condition`\\n- `damage`\\n- `healing`\\n- `spawn` / `spawn_token`\\n- `map_image` / `map_change`\\n\\nExample:\\n\\n```json\\n{\\n  \\\"dynamicEvents\\\": [\\n    {\\n      \\\"id\\\": \\\"floor-breaks\\\",\\n      \\\"name\\\": \\\"The Floor Breaks\\\",\\n      \\\"trigger\\\": \\\"round_start\\\",\\n      \\\"round\\\": 2,\\n      \\\"actions\\\": [\\n        {\\\"type\\\": \\\"message\\\", \\\"message\\\": \\\"The central floor tears open.\\\"},\\n        {\\\"type\\\": \\\"terrain\\\", \\\"terrain\\\": \\\"hazard\\\", \\\"rect\\\": {\\\"x\\\": 11, \\\"y\\\": 7, \\\"width\\\": 4, \\\"height\\\": 2}}\\n      ]\\n    },\\n    {\\n      \\\"id\\\": \\\"reinforcements\\\",\\n      \\\"name\\\": \\\"Reinforcements\\\",\\n      \\\"trigger\\\": \\\"round_start\\\",\\n      \\\"round\\\": 3,\\n      \\\"actions\\\": [\\n        {\\n          \\\"type\\\": \\\"spawn\\\",\\n          \\\"tokens\\\": [\\n            {\\\"type\\\": \\\"hostile\\\", \\\"name\\\": \\\"Ash Goblin Reinforcement\\\", \\\"x\\\": 27, \\\"y\\\": 2, \\\"hp\\\": 12, \\\"maxHp\\\": 12, \\\"ac\\\": 13, \\\"speed\\\": 30, \\\"initiativeBonus\\\": 2, \\\"actions\\\": [{\\\"name\\\": \\\"Scimitar\\\", \\\"toHit\\\": 4, \\\"damageRoll\\\": \\\"1d6+2\\\", \\\"damageType\\\": \\\"slashing\\\", \\\"rangeFeet\\\": 5}]}\\n          ]\\n        }\\n      ]\\n    }\\n  ]\\n}\\n```\\n\\nSpawned tokens are moved to the nearest legal unoccupied footprint when their requested position is unavailable.\\n\\n## RandomEncounters placeholder\\n\\n`assets/RandomEncounters/` contains placeholder `css`, `js`, and `json` directories. Future RandomEncounters files can load tokens from `assets/tokens/` or the configured GitHub token manifest. ActiveWorkspace does not require those future files to exist in order to run.\\n\"}");

entries.content: export default JSON.parse("{\"schema\":\"ai-brain-source-note/1.0\",\"domain\":\"vtt-maps\",\"capabilities\":[\"canon\",\"crop\",\"grid\",\"layer\",\"map\",\"perspective\"],\"provenance\":{\"sourceGroup\":\"active-session-runtime-c\",\"sourceType\":\"provided-project-material\",\"archiveHash\":\"be64160633c6ca96\"},\"title\":\"grid_formats.md\",\"content\":\"# ActiveWorkspace Canonical Grid Formats\\n\\nAll encounter maps are expected to use one of the supplied grid overlays or a tiled/resized derivative of them. ActiveWorkspace treats every square as **5 ft \u00d7 5 ft**, regardless of source resolution.\\n\\n| Source grid | Image size | Grid squares | Source pixels per square |\\n|---|---:|---:|---:|\\n| `Grid (17x22).png` | 5100 \u00d7 6600 | 34 \u00d7 44 | 150 \u00d7 150 |\\n| `Grid (22x17).png` | 3300 \u00d7 2550 | 22 \u00d7 17 | 150 \u00d7 150 |\\n| `Grid (8.5x11).png` | 2550 \u00d7 3300 | 17 \u00d7 22 | 150 \u00d7 150 |\\n| `Seamless Grid Pattern (1x1).png` | 1200 \u00d7 1200 | 8 \u00d7 8 | 150 \u00d7 150 |\\n| `Seamless Grid Pattern (2x2).png` | 2400 \u00d7 2400 | 16 \u00d7 16 | 150 \u00d7 150 |\\n| `Seamless Grid Pattern (3x3).png` | 3600 \u00d7 3600 | 24 \u00d7 24 | 150 \u00d7 150 |\\n\\n## Detection behavior\\n\\n1. Exact source dimensions use an immediate canonical profile match.\\n2. Maps tiled from the supplied 150-pixel pattern are snapped to the same family after line verification.\\n3. Resized or composited maps use alpha-aware and luminance-aware periodic line scanning.\\n4. Transparent black grid overlays are detected from their alpha channel rather than incorrectly read as solid black images.\\n5. Cropped maps retain detected origin and grid bounds.\\n6. Manual rows and columns remain available for perspective-distorted or heavily obscured maps.\\n\\nThe runtime profile registry is in `json/canonical_grid_profiles.json`. The source references are in `assets/grids/canonical/`.\\n\"}");
